EmailTemplate.name: FTF Application Steps
EmailTemplate.subject: Steps for applying to Arizona State University
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in Arizona State University. I have included some information below to help you with the application process.
Your first step is to review our freshman admission requirements online at https://students.asu.edu/freshman/requirements. Some majors have additional requirements, which can be viewed by searching for your major on degree search at https://asu.edu/degrees.
Once you’re ready, follow the application steps below:
1. Apply for admission 2. Pay the application fee online 3. Request to have your ACT or SAT scores sent directly to ASU from ACT or College Board 4. Request official transcripts from each educational institution attended be sent directly to ASU Admission Services*
Once we receive all materials, your file will be reviewed for admission. The review process may take four to six weeks.
*If you self-report your grades, you do not need to submit an official transcript to receive your admission decision. An official transcript will be required once you graduate from high school.
After you apply to ASU, you’ll receive an email and a letter containing your ASURITE UserID and activation code. Follow the instructions to activate your login for My ASU (https://my.asu.edu). You will be able to track your admission status and take care of any Priority Tasks needed to complete your application.
If you have any questions, let me know and I will be happy to help.
{!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c} {!User.Recruiter_Title__c} Admission Services {!User.Recruiter_Email__c} {!User.Recruiter_Phone__c}
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
